evals.name: constraint-card
evals.prompt: Constraint card: core verb = tend; setting = a lighthouse on a foggy island; twist = the fog remembers what you did yesterday; session length = 10 minutes; scope = solo developer, 3 months. Pick the target fun and derive the mechanics.
evals.expected_output: Exactly 2 or 3 target aesthetics, each with a one-sentence experience goal; the other kinds listed as deprioritized; an MDA table; an aesthetic trace with a KEEP/FLAG/CUT verdict per mechanic; a JSON block that names all eight kinds once.
expectations: Picks exactly 2 or 3 target aesthetics
Each target has a one-sentence experience goal
Names the deprioritized kinds
Traces every mechanic to an aesthetic with a verdict

checks.description: sections in order
2-3 target aesthetics
checks.expr: 2 <= len(d['aesthetics']) <= 3

checks.description: targets + deprioritized cover all 8 kinds once
checks.expr: sorted([a['kind'] for a in d['aesthetics']] + d['deprioritized']) == sorted(['Sensation','Fantasy','Narrative','Challenge','Fellowship','Discovery','Expression','Submission'])

checks.description: every goal is one 'The player feels' sentence
checks.expr: all(a['goal'].startswith('The player feels') for a in d['aesthetics'])

checks.description: every trace row has a valid verdict
checks.expr: len(d['trace']) >= 3 and all(t['verdict'] in ('KEEP','FLAG','CUT') for t in d['trace'])

evals.name: trace-every-listed-mechanic
evals.prompt: Concept: a cozy puzzle game where you rearrange furniture in tiny apartments so the tenants can reach their morning routine. Current mechanics: drag-and-rotate furniture, tenant path preview, undo stack, daily login streak rewards, global leaderboard of fastest solves, unlockable wallpaper patterns. Which of these mechanics earn their place?
evals.expected_output: Every one of the six listed mechanics appears in the trace. Mechanics that serve no target aesthetic are marked CUT or FLAG; the login streak is not KEEP unless tied to a target.
expectations: All six listed mechanics appear in the aesthetic trace
At least one listed mechanic is marked CUT or FLAG
Picks exactly 2 or 3 target aesthetics

checks.description: 2-3 target aesthetics
checks.expr: 2 <= len(d['aesthetics']) <= 3

checks.description: all 6 listed mechanics traced
checks.expr: all(any(k in t['mechanic'].lower() for t in d['trace']) for k in ['drag','preview','undo','streak','leaderboard','wallpaper'])

checks.description: at least one CUT or FLAG
checks.expr: any(t['verdict'] in ('CUT','FLAG') for t in d['trace'])

checks.description: CUT rows serve none
checks.expr: all(t['serves'].lower() == 'none' for t in d['trace'] if t['verdict'] == 'CUT')

checks.description: trace table present

evals.name: too-many-aesthetics-given
evals.prompt: Upstream picked these target aesthetics: Discovery, Expression, Fellowship, Sensation. Concept: two players share one garden across time zones; each tends it while the other sleeps and leaves notes in the soil.
evals.expected_output: Keeps exactly 3 of the 4 supplied aesthetics (the first 3), records the dropped one under Assumptions, and still traces every mechanic.
expectations: Outputs exactly 3 target aesthetics, not 4
States under Assumptions that one supplied aesthetic was dropped
Does not ask the user a question

checks.description: exactly 3 aesthetics kept from the supplied 4
checks.expr: len(d['aesthetics']) == 3 and set(a['kind'] for a in d['aesthetics']) <= {'Discovery','Expression','Fellowship','Sensation'}

checks.description: assumption records the cap
no question to the user
checks.pattern: (would you like|do you want|could you (tell|clarify)|let me know which)

evals.name: given-blend-kept
evals.prompt:
Concept: Soup Relay — two to four friends run one night-market soup stall; the ladle, the bowls and the till are at opposite ends of a tiny cart. Session length: 8 minutes.
Blend: team-under-pressure (Team under pressure). Kinds: Fellowship, Challenge, Sensation. Signature dynamic: Players shout, hand off and cover for each other under a clock, so every save is shared, tense and physical at once. Loop pattern: A player grabs and passes an item → the shared goal advances or a task goes wrong → a loud, juicy cue shows who needs help → the team decides who covers the gap next.
Pick the target fun and derive the mechanics.
evals.expected_output: Targets exactly Fellowship, Challenge, Sensation in that order with Fellowship as primary; the Blend line names team-under-pressure; the MDA table contains the signature dynamic; a fold-in check shows every kind produced by a moment or session mechanic.
expectations: Keeps exactly the blend's kinds in the blend's order
Fellowship is the primary
The MDA table contains the blend's signature dynamic
Every target kind has a KEEP mechanic in the moment or session loop

checks.description: sections in order, with the blend line and fold-in check
exactly the blend's kinds, in order
checks.expr: [a['kind'] for a in d['aesthetics']] == ['Fellowship', 'Challenge', 'Sensation']

checks.description: blend id and primary
checks.expr: d['blend'] == 'team-under-pressure' and d['primary'] == 'Fellowship'

checks.description: signature dynamic inside the MDA table
checks.pattern: (?s)^## MDA table(?:(?!\n## ).)*Players shout, hand off and cover for each other under a clock

checks.description: every target kind folded into moment or session
checks.expr: all(any(a['kind'] in t['serves'] and t['verdict'] == 'KEEP' and t.get('loop') in ('moment','session') for t in d['trace']) for a in d['aesthetics'])

checks.description: every trace row names a valid loop
checks.expr: all(t.get('loop') in ('moment','session','long-term','side') for t in d['trace'])

evals.name: picks-a-deck-blend
evals.prompt: Concept: Kite Post — you glide a paper kite over a windy valley to carry letters between hilltop villages; gusts change every morning.
evals.expected_output: Without a given blend, picks one blend from references/blends.md, uses its kinds with the first as primary, and says under Assumptions why the blend fits the core verb.
expectations: The blend id exists in blends.md
The primary is the first target kind
Assumptions explain the blend choice

checks.description: blend id comes from the deck
checks.expr: d['blend'] in ['team-under-pressure', 'party-performance', 'flow-mastery', 'clever-solve', 'curious-expedition', 'object-story', 'life-in-a-role', 'job-fantasy', 'embodied-rider', 'sensory-drift', 'cozy-builder', 'shared-sandbox', 'silent-companions', 'soothing-restore', 'daily-garden', 'network-puzzle']

checks.description: primary is the first target
checks.expr: d['primary'] == d['aesthetics'][0]['kind'] and 2 <= len(d['aesthetics']) <= 3

checks.description: blend line present
assumptions explain the blend
every target kind folded into moment or session
checks.expr: all(any(a['kind'] in t['serves'] and t['verdict'] == 'KEEP' and t.get('loop') in ('moment','session') for t in d['trace']) for a in d['aesthetics'])

checks.description: no question to the user
checks.pattern: (would you like|do you want|could you (tell|clarify)|let me know which)

evals.name: cosmetic-expression-redesigned
evals.prompt:
Concept: Lantern Row — rotate mirrors to route one beam of light through a night market until every lantern is lit.
Blend: network-puzzle (Growing network). Kinds: Challenge, Expression.
Current mechanics: rotate mirrors, a 60-second timer per board, a star rating per board, a cosmetic shop that sells lantern skins for stars. Every board has exactly one solution. Today Expression comes only from the lantern skin shop.
Pick the target fun and derive the mechanics.
evals.expected_output: Keeps Challenge and Expression. The fold-in check finds Expression bolted on (only the cosmetic shop) and redesigns the core loop, for example many valid mirror layouts, so a moment or session mechanic produces Expression. The shop stays a side or long-term mechanic and does not pass the check.
expectations: Keeps Expression as a target instead of dropping it
Redesigns the core loop so a moment or session mechanic produces Expression
Does not pass the fold-in check with the cosmetic shop

checks.description: keeps the blend's kinds
checks.expr: [a['kind'] for a in d['aesthetics']] == ['Challenge', 'Expression'] and d['blend'] == 'network-puzzle'

checks.description: Expression from a core-loop mechanic that is not the shop
checks.expr: any('Expression' in t['serves'] and t['verdict'] == 'KEEP' and t.get('loop') in ('moment','session') and not any(w in t['mechanic'].lower() for w in ('shop', 'skin', 'cosmetic')) for t in d['trace'])

checks.description: the shop is not a core-loop mechanic
checks.expr: all(t.get('loop') in ('long-term','side') for t in d['trace'] if 'shop' in t['mechanic'].lower() or 'skin' in t['mechanic'].lower())

checks.description: every target kind folded into moment or session
checks.expr: all(any(a['kind'] in t['serves'] and t['verdict'] == 'KEEP' and t.get('loop') in ('moment','session') for t in d['trace']) for a in d['aesthetics'])

checks.description: fold-in check records a redesign
